description: Returns what each NFL defense allows per game to QBs, RBs, WRs or TEs: fantasy points plus yards, TDs, receptions and targets, from ESPN box scores, ranked so rank 1 allows the most (the best matchup). Use it for matchup-based start/sit and streaming, optionally over the last N weeks. Pro plan (Free and Basic keys get 403 pro_required).

last.description: Only the trailing N weeks with games, 1-18. Default: the whole season.
last.title: Last

position.description: QB, RB, WR or TE. Default: all four.
position.title: Position

scoring.description: Fantasy scoring: ppr (full PPR, the default), half (half-PPR) or standard.
scoring.title: Scoring

team.description: Only this defense. Team code, e.g. BUF or KC. LA/LAR, WSH/WAS and JAC/JAX are interchangeable.
team.title: Team

name: get_defense_vs_position

by_position.description: Without position: QB, RB, WR and TE lists.

defenses.description: Per defense: fantasy points, yards, TDs, receptions and targets allowed per game, and rank.

error.description: Present only when the call failed: what went wrong.

note.description: A sentence for the user saying which plan is needed.

rank_meaning.description: rank 1 = allows the most (the best matchup).

reason.description: Machine-readable failure reason, e.g. basic_required or pro_required.

required_plan.description: The plan that unlocks this data: basic or pro.

status.description: HTTP status of the failed API call.

updated_at.description: When the data was last loaded.

title: Defense vs position (matchup strength)
